tools.name: prompt-version-manager

action.description: Operation to perform: 'save' stores a prompt version, 'list' shows all versions for a key, 'diff' computes line-level diff between two versions, 'restore' retrieves a specific version's content, 'delete' removes a version.

key.description: Logical name for the prompt (e.g., 'auth-system-prompt', 'onboarding-spec'). Groups versions under a shared identifier.

content.description: Prompt content to save (required for 'save' action).

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the version (e.g., 'v1-initial', 'v2-with-cot').

versionA.description: Version ID or label for the base side of a diff (required for 'diff' action).

versionB.description: Version ID or label for the comparison side of a diff (required for 'diff' action). Omit to diff against the latest saved version.

versionId.description: Specific version ID to restore or delete (required for 'restore' and 'delete' actions).

includeMetadata.description: Include version metadata (timestamp, label, character count) in the response.

tools.description: Version and manage prompt artifacts with save, list, diff, restore, and delete operations using an in-memory registry of named prompt versions and optional metadata output. BEST FOR: prompt lifecycle management, iterative prompt refinement, A/B comparison of prompt variants, rollback to previous prompt versions. OUTPUTS: Version metadata, line-level diffs between versions, restored prompt content, or deletion confirmation.
